<span className="wix-method wix-method-get">GET</span>

<div className="wix-api-columns">

<div className="wix-ref">

<Info>

  **Developer Preview.** This method is in Developer Preview and may change without notice.

</Info>

Returns a list of waitlisted entries.
Each WaitingListEntry returned holds the current Waitlist registrations, configuration and suggesting status.
> **Permissions**
> This endpoint requires the Read Bookings - Public Data permissions scope

## Endpoint

```http
GET /v1/waitingList
```

## Query Params

<ParamField query="waitingResources" type="string[]" required>

  List of sessions (waitingResources) with active waitlists.

</ParamField>

## Response Object

<ResponseField name="list" type="WaitingListEntry[]">

  <Expandable title="list properties">

    <ResponseField name="waitingResource" type="string">

      The waitlisted session ID.

    </ResponseField>

    <ResponseField name="registrations" type="Registration[]">

      List of registrants to the waitlist.

      <Expandable title="registrations properties">

        <ResponseField name="id" type="string">

          Registration ID

        </ResponseField>

        <ResponseField name="bookingId" type="string">

          Registration's associated booking

        </ResponseField>

        <ResponseField name="waitingResource" type="string">

          Resource to be waitlisted for.
          Currently only supports session ID.

        </ResponseField>

        <ResponseField name="availableActions" type="AvailableActions">

          Currently available actions for this registration.

          _Nested structure omitted for brevity — see the `AvailableActions` object._

        </ResponseField>

        <ResponseField name="status" type="string">

          Registration status
          WAITING - Registrant is on the waitlist. Waiting to be suggested a spot.
          SUGGESTING - Registrant is currently being suggested an opened spot.
          DECLINED - Registration has been declined.
          ENROLLED - Registrant has been enrolled to a suggested spot.

          **Supported values:**

          - `UNDEFINED`
          - `WAITING`
          - `SUGGESTING`
          - `DECLINED`
          - `ENROLLED`

        </ResponseField>

      </Expandable>

    </ResponseField>

    <ResponseField name="numberOfRegistrations" type="integer" />

    <ResponseField name="capacity" type="integer">

      Waitlisted session's capacity. Defined as part of the service's booking policy.

    </ResponseField>

    <ResponseField name="timeWindowMinutes" type="integer">

      Waitlisted session's "suggesting" time window. Defined as part of the service's booking policy.

    </ResponseField>

    <ResponseField name="status" type="string">

      The Waitlist's current status:
      IDLE - Waiting for a cancellation that will free up a spot in the session.
      SUGGESTING - Currently suggesting a free spot to a registrant in the waitlist. The service will keep suggesting until the end of the list is reached, or until all free spots are filled.
      OPEN_TO_ALL - Once we got to the end of the list - booking is opened for the session, and any registrant on the list can book.

      **Supported values:**

      - `UNDEFINED`
      - `IDLE`
      - `SUGGESTING`
      - `OPEN_TO_ALL`

    </ResponseField>

  </Expandable>

</ResponseField>

## Errors

<Note>

  This method doesn't return any custom errors, but may return standard errors. [Learn more about standard Wix errors](https://dev.wix.com/docs/rest/articles/getting-started/errors).

</Note>
